summary: Bulk locale information query. Reads the LCID from word_8D3F88 and runs a chain of sub_5968F6 queries that fill a caller structure at offsets a1 + 12 through a1 + 47 with locale values (LCTYPE codes 0x14-0x18, 0x1A, 0x19, 0x50-0x57). The digit string stored at field offset 0x1C is post-processed in place by InPlaceDigitCharConversionStripSemicolons. Returns the OR of all query results: 0 means every query succeeded, nonzero means at least one failed; returns -1 immediately when a1 is NULL.

operations.description: Guard: if a1 is NULL, return -1 immediately.
Load the locale handle: v1 = (unsigned __int16)word_8D3F88; used as the LCID argument for every subsequent query.
Query LCTYPE 0x15 into a1 + 12 via sub_5968F6 and seed the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x14 into a1 + 16 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x16 into a1 + 20 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x17 into a1 + 24 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x18 into a1 + 28 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Read the char-pointer field at offset 0x1C (a1 + 28) and convert the semicolon-separated digit string in place via InPlaceDigitCharConversionStripSemicolons.
Query LCTYPE 0x50 into a1 + 32 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x51 into a1 + 36 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x1A into a1 + 40 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x19 into a1 + 41 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x54 into a1 + 42 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x55 into a1 + 43 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x56 into a1 + 44 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x57 into a1 + 45 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x52 into a1 + 46 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Query LCTYPE 0x53 into a1 + 47 via sub_5968F6 and OR into the accumulated result.
Return the OR of all sub_5968F6 results: 0 means every query succeeded, nonzero means at least one failed.

unresolved: The exact locale value behind each LCTYPE code is not established by this packet; the codes cluster around number/currency formatting (0x14-0x18, 0x1A, 0x19, 0x50-0x57) but their ordering differs from GetLocaleInfoW's numbering.
The mode flag (1 vs 0) passed as the first argument to sub_5968F6 distinguishes two query variants whose semantics are unresolved here.
a1 points to an unnamed structure; only offsets a1 + 12 through a1 + 47 are written and offset 0x1C is read as a char pointer.
